sections.description:
Fleek Reviews for Google Business integrates with Google Places API to display your business reviews on WordPress websites.

🚀 Key Features

📥 GOOGLE INTEGRATION
* Direct Google Places API connection
* Live review fetching (respects Google’s 5-review API limit)
* Duplicate removal system
* Spam filtering

🎨 DISPLAY OPTIONS
* 4 Layouts: Grid, List, Slider, Masonry
* 4 Themes: Light, Dark, Glassmorphism, Minimal
* Responsive Design: Works on all devices
* Customizable Columns: 1-4 column layouts

⚡ PERFORMANCE FEATURES
* Caching system (1-168 hours configurable)
* Auto-refresh via WordPress cron
* Lazy loading images
* Minified assets
* CDN compatible

🛠️ DISPLAY METHODS
* Shortcode: [flgr_google_reviews] – Simple integration
* Gutenberg Block: Block editor support
* WordPress Widget: Sidebar and footer ready
* PHP Function: For developers

🎛️ FILTERING OPTIONS
* Show only 5-star reviews
* Filter by rating range (1-5 stars)
* Limit number of reviews
* Hide/show avatars, ratings, dates
* Business reply display

📈 SEO FEATURES
* Schema.org markup included
* Rich snippets support
* Local SEO compatible
* Structured data

External Services

This plugin relies on the Google Maps Places API to retrieve business reviews and information. The plugin connects to Google’s servers to fetch review data when needed.

Google Maps Places API
* Service Provider: Google LLC
* Service Used: Google Maps Places API (Place Details endpoint)
* Purpose: To retrieve business reviews, ratings, and business information from Google
* Data Sent: Your Google API key and business Place ID are sent to Google’s servers
* When Data is Sent:
– When the plugin initially fetches reviews
– When the cache expires (configurable from 1-168 hours)
– When manually refreshing reviews from the admin panel
– When testing the API connection in settings
* API Endpoint: https://maps.googleapis.com/maps/api/place/details/json
* Terms of Service: https://cloud.google.com/maps-platform/terms
* Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

Google Cloud Console
* Service URL: https://console.cloud.google.com/
* Purpose: Used to create and manage API keys for the Google Places API
* Note: This is accessed by the site administrator only for initial setup

Google Place ID Finder
* Service URL: https://developers.google.com/maps/documentation/places/web-service/place-id
* Purpose: Tool to find your business’s Place ID required for the plugin
* Note: This is accessed by the site administrator only during setup

Data Usage Notice:
– No user data is transmitted to external services
– Only your business information (Place ID) and API credentials are used
– All retrieved data is cached locally to minimize API calls
– The plugin does not store or transmit any visitor/customer data

API Limitations:
– Google Places API returns a maximum of 5 reviews per request (Google’s limitation)
– Free tier includes 100,000 requests per month
– Our caching system minimizes API usage

🌟 Plugin Features

✅ NO CODING REQUIRED
Set up in minutes with step-by-step guide

✅ GOOGLE API COMPLIANT
Respects Google’s terms and limitations

✅ TRANSLATION READY
Multi-language support included

✅ DEVELOPER FRIENDLY
Hooks, filters, and extensible architecture

📊 Suitable For:

  • Local Businesses – Restaurants, salons, clinics
  • E-commerce Stores – Display customer reviews
  • Service Providers – Lawyers, consultants, agencies
  • Real Estate – Show client testimonials
  • Healthcare – Display patient reviews
  • Any Business – With Google My Business listing

🎯 Google API Limitation Notice

Important: Google Places API returns maximum 5 reviews per request. This is Google’s official limitation that applies to ALL plugins and applications using their API.

How we handle these 5 reviews:
* ✅ Remove duplicate reviews automatically
* ✅ Sort by rating and date for display
* ✅ Filtering options (show only 5-star, etc.)
* ✅ Efficient caching to minimize API calls
* ✅ Multiple shortcodes for different rating filters

🚀 Quick Start Guide

  1. Install & Activate the plugin
  2. Get Google API Key from Google Cloud Console
  3. Find Your Place ID using Google’s tool
  4. Configure Settings in WordPress admin
  5. Add Shortcode [flgr_google_reviews] anywhere
  6. Display Reviews on your site

💡 Usage Tips

  • Use [flgr_google_reviews exact_rating="5"] for landing pages
  • Slider layout works well in hero sections
  • Grid layout suitable for sidebars
  • Set cache to 24 hours for performance

🔧 Shortcode Examples

Basic Usage (Uses Admin Settings):
[flgr_google_reviews]

Custom Layout & Theme:
[flgr_google_reviews layout=”slider” theme=”dark”]

Show Only 5-Star Reviews:
[flgr_google_reviews exact_rating=”5″]

Specific Count & Columns:
[flgr_google_reviews count=”3″ columns=”3″]

Hide Avatars & Dates:
[flgr_google_reviews show_avatars=”false” show_dates=”false”]

🌐 Multilingual Support

  • English (default)
  • Translation ready (.pot file included)
  • RTL language support
  • Automatic locale detection for Google API

🔒 Privacy & Security

  • No data stored on external servers
  • GDPR compliant
  • Secure API key handling
  • WordPress security standards followed

📞 Support & Documentation

  • Installation guide included
  • Built-in connection testing tool
  • Cache status monitoring
  • Debug logging for troubleshooting
  • FAQ section with common solutions

sections.installation:
🚀 Automatic Installation

  1. Go to Plugins → Add New in WordPress admin
  2. Search for “Fleek Reviews for Google Business”
  3. Click “Install Now” and then “Activate”
  4. Follow the setup guide

📁 Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file
  2. Go to Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin
  3. Choose the ZIP file and click “Install Now”
  4. Activate the plugin

⚙️ Configuration Setup

Step 1: Get Google Places API Key
1. Visit Google Cloud Console
2. Create or select a project
3. Enable Places API
4. Create an API Key
5. Restrict the key for security

Step 2: Find Your Business Place ID
1. Use Google Place ID Finder
2. Search for your business
3. Copy the Place ID

Step 3: Configure Plugin
1. Go to Fleek Reviews → Settings
2. Enter your API Key and Place ID
3. Click “Test Connection” to verify
4. Configure display preferences
5. Save settings

Step 4: Display Reviews
Add [flgr_google_reviews] shortcode to any page, post, or widget area.
sections.faq:
🤔 Why only 5 reviews maximum?

This is a Google Places API limitation, not our plugin limitation. Google’s official API returns maximum 5 reviews per request for ANY application or plugin. This applies to all review plugins.

How we handle these 5 reviews:
* Remove duplicates automatically
* Sort by rating and date
* Allow multiple shortcodes with different filters
* Caching to get fresh reviews regularly

💰 Is this plugin free?

Yes, completely free! Google Places API has a generous free tier (100,000 requests/month) which is sufficient for most websites with our caching system.

🔄 How often do reviews update?

Reviews are cached for performance. Default is 24 hours, but you can configure it from 1-168 hours. Auto-refresh keeps reviews updated automatically via WordPress cron.

⭐ Can I show only 5-star reviews?

Yes! Use: [flgr_google_reviews exact_rating="5"]

You can also filter by rating ranges or show specific ratings only.

📱 Is it mobile responsive?

Yes! All layouts automatically adapt to mobile, tablet, and desktop screens.

🎨 Can I customize the design?

Yes! Choose from:
* 4 layouts (Grid, List, Slider, Masonry)
* 4 themes (Light, Dark, Glassmorphism, Minimal)
* Customizable columns, colors, and spacing
* Hide/show various elements

🔌 Does it work with caching plugins?

Compatible with major caching plugins:
* WP Rocket
* W3 Total Cache
* WP Super Cache
* LiteSpeed Cache
* And more

🌐 Does it work with page builders?

Yes! Works with:
* Elementor
* Divi
* Beaver Builder
* Visual Composer
* Gutenberg (native block included)
* Any page builder that supports shortcodes

🔧 What if I have multiple business locations?

You can use multiple shortcodes with different Place IDs:
[flgr_google_reviews place_id=”ChIJN1t_tDeuEmsRUsoyG83frY4″]

📊 Does it help with SEO?

Yes! The plugin includes:
* Schema.org markup for rich snippets
* Structured data for search engines
* Local SEO support
* Increased engagement

🚨 What if reviews don’t show?

Common solutions:
1. Check API key and Place ID are correct
2. Ensure Places API is enabled in Google Cloud
3. Verify your business has Google reviews
4. Check rating filters aren’t too restrictive
5. Use “Test Connection” button in settings

🛠️ Can developers extend this plugin?

Yes! Developer-friendly features:
* WordPress hooks and filters
* Clean, documented code
* Extensible architecture
* Custom CSS classes
* PHP functions available

🔒 Is my data secure?

Yes:
* No data stored on external servers
* API keys encrypted in database
* GDPR compliant
* WordPress security standards followed

📞 Do you provide support?

Support included:
* Built-in troubleshooting tools
* Detailed documentation
* FAQ section
* Debug logging system
* Connection testing tools
